namespace PubAV09
structure Vec3 where
  x : Int
  y : Int
  z : Int
def add3 (u v : Vec3) : Vec3 := ⟨u.x + v.x, u.y + v.y, u.z + v.z⟩
def dot3 (u v : Vec3) : Int := u.x * v.x + u.y * v.y + u.z * v.z
theorem dot3_comm (u v : Vec3) : dot3 u v = dot3 v u := by sorry
theorem dot3_bilinear (u v w : Vec3) : dot3 (add3 u v) w = dot3 u w + dot3 v w := by sorry
end PubAV09
